title: Can We Get Much Higher
blurb: Justin Vernon sings the opening line of Kanye West's Dark Fantasy, and edit culture turned it into the definitive sound of ascension. One Piece edits made it legendary — the vocal soars, the character powers up, the timing lines up perfectly every single time — and now anything climbing has a legitimate claim to it. Sports miracles, anime transformations, a graph going the right way, a person deciding to sort their life out. For altitude of every kind, literal and emotional, and it never once undersells the moment.
origin: The 'Dark Fantasy' vocal, canonized by One Piece and hype edits.
